annotations.title: Outbound Agent URL SSRF, Metadata & Secret Exfiltration Firewall

description: Static validation firewall for outbound network destination URIs against cloud metadata IP addresses (169.254.169.254), RFC 1918 private IP blocks, and query-string secret exfiltration before agent dispatch. Use when validating a user-supplied or tool-supplied URI destination before network dispatch; for auditing local shell commands or general prompts, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'destination_uri' ('egress_policy' defaults to 'block_private_and_metadata'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

destination_uri.description: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS destination URI to inspect before fetching (e.g. 'https://api.example.com/v1/webhook').

egress_policy.description: Network egress policy; defaults to 'block_private_and_metadata' when omitted.

name: audit_outbound_egress_url

egress_allowed.description: True if the URL targets a safe public endpoint with no exfiltration tokens.

exfiltration_query_params.description: Query parameters suspected of carrying leaked secrets or base64 payloads.

ssrf_risk_detected.description: True if loopback, RFC1918 private IP, or cloud metadata IP is targeted.
